cid, road, s = crossings_list[0]["id"], crossings_list[0]["road"], crossings_list[0]["road_s"]

                           description="Cross a road while a bus approaches; avoid it.")

                      avoid=["Bus1"], timeout=60,
                      success="You crossed safely.", failure="The bus hit you. Look before you cross.")
